Terms of service

Effective 2026-10-20

These terms are an agreement between you and KeyHelm LLC ("KeyHelm", "we", "us") for using the KeyHelm website and service. By creating an account or using the service, you agree to them.

1. What KeyHelm is, and is not

KeyHelm is software that helps rental owners communicate with tenants, prospects and vendors and keep track of their rentals. It is not a property management company, real estate broker, law firm, emergency service or payment processor for rent. You remain the landlord and are responsible for your properties, your decisions and your legal obligations. Nothing in the service is legal, tax or financial advice.

2. Your account

  • You must be at least 18 and able to enter a contract. You must give accurate information and keep your login details secure.
  • You are responsible for what happens under your account and for the information you enter, including your rules, policies, rent amounts, vendor list and lease template.

3. Your responsibilities as an owner

  • Fair housing. You must follow federal, Colorado and local fair housing laws. KeyHelm does not score, rank or recommend applicants. You make every application decision.
  • Landlord law. You are responsible for following Colorado landlord-tenant law, including repair timelines, notice requirements, late fee limits, deposit return deadlines and rent payment rules. The service includes reminders based on Colorado rules, but they may not cover every situation and are not legal advice.
  • Rent and money. Tenants pay you directly. KeyHelm never collects, holds or moves rent, security deposits or vendor payments. You pay your vendors directly.
  • Consent to contact. You confirm you have the right to give us the contact details of your tenants and vendors and that we may contact them on your behalf about your rentals.
  • Your lease. You supply your own lease. We fill in the details you provide; we do not review it for legal compliance.

4. Automated messages and AI

The service uses automated systems, including an AI model, to reply to messages and route requests. Automated replies can be wrong or incomplete. You can review conversations at any time. Emergencies are flagged and routed, but KeyHelm is not an emergency service: anyone in danger should call 911.

5. Text messaging

  • The program. KeyHelm text messages are sent by KeyHelm LLC on behalf of landlords who use KeyHelm: repair updates, rent reminders and late notices, showing scheduling, lease, renewal, move-in and move-out notices, replies to messages people send, job requests to the landlord's vendors, and account alerts for owners who opt in. Details and sample messages are on our text messages page. We never send marketing texts.
  • Owners' consent. Texts about your account are optional. You can opt in when you sign up, and consent is not a condition of purchase. If you don't opt in, we send your alerts by email.
  • Tenants, applicants, prospects and vendors. As an owner, you may add a person's mobile number only if they have agreed to get texts from you about your rental, and only for messages about the rental. People who text your KeyHelm number first get replies to what they asked. Each tenant's first text explains the program and how to stop.
  • How often. Message frequency varies.
  • Cost. Message and data rates may apply.
  • Help and stopping. Reply HELP for help or STOP to cancel at any time. Reply START to turn texts back on. You can also email admin@keyhelm.app.
  • Carriers. Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
  • Privacy. No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging opt-in data and consent are not shared with any third parties. See our Privacy policy.

6. Plans, billing and automatic renewal

  • Prices are per rental home ("door") per month, shown on our website at the time you sign up. Your first month is charged when you sign up.
  • Month-to-month plans renew automatically every month and are charged to your payment method on file until you cancel.
  • 12-month agreements are billed monthly at a lower per-door price for 12 months. We email you at least 30 days before the 12 months end. Unless you cancel or choose a new term, the agreement then continues month to month at the same agreement price, and you can cancel at any time after that. If you cancel before the 12 months are up, see "Ending a 12-month agreement early" in our Refund and cancellation policy.
  • If you add or remove homes, your next charges will reflect the new number of doors.
  • Private offers are personal, time-limited and apply only as described in the offer.
  • We may change prices with at least 30 days' notice by email. Changes apply from your next billing period after the notice period. If you do not agree, you can cancel before the change takes effect.
  • Prices do not include any taxes that may apply.

7. Cancellation and refunds

See our Refund and cancellation policy, which is part of these terms.

You may not use the service to break the law, discriminate, harass anyone, send spam or marketing texts without consent, upload malware, try to access other accounts, overload the service, or copy or resell it. We may limit how often the service can be used to protect it for everyone, and we may suspend accounts that break these rules.

You own the information you put into the service. You give us permission to use it to provide and support the service as described in our Privacy policy. You can export or ask us to delete it by emailing admin@keyhelm.app.

10. Our service

We work to keep the service available and accurate, but we provide it "as is" and "as available". We do not promise it will be uninterrupted or error-free, or that it will meet every legal requirement for your situation.

11. Limits on our liability

KeyHelm is software that helps you manage your rentals. It is not a law firm, a licensed property manager or a real estate broker, and it does not give legal advice. You remain the landlord: you make the decisions you approve in the service (such as applicants, repairs over your limit, fees, notices and lease terms) and you are responsible for following the laws that apply to you.

To the fullest extent the law allows: (a) we are not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential losses, such as lost rent, lost profits or vacancy costs; and (b) our total liability for any claim related to the service is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim arose. These limits do not apply where the law does not allow them, such as for fraud, gross negligence or willful misconduct.

You agree to cover claims, losses and reasonable costs that result from your breaking the law (including fair housing law) or these terms while using the service.

12. Ending these terms

You can stop using the service at any time by cancelling as described in the Refund and cancellation policy. We may suspend or end your account if you seriously or repeatedly break these terms, or if required by law. We will give notice when we reasonably can.

13. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. If a change is significant, we will email owners at least 30 days before it takes effect. Continuing to use the service after that means you accept the new terms.

14. Law and disputes

These terms are governed by Colorado law. If you have a concern, email admin@keyhelm.app first and we will try to resolve it within 30 days. If we can't, either of us may bring the claim in the state courts located in Arapahoe County, Colorado, or in small claims court where the claim qualifies.
